text: :rotating_light: ALERT booking-service error rate 43% (threshold 2%). p99 latency 30s+. All tenants affected.
Declaring sev1 per the incident runbook. Ana, can you IC? I think this is my migration — timing lines up with 0007 going out.
IC here. Confirmed: index build from migration 0007 is holding an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on bookings. Every clinic's writes are queued behind it. Options: wait it out (est 2h+) or kill and revert.
Customer comms going out now using the runbook template — 'investigating an issue affecting bookings, next update in 30 minutes.' Nadia is calling Kettleworth directly since it's mid-morning there.
Reverted via 0008, locks cleared, error rate back under 1%. Standing reminder from tonight: one bad lock hits every clinic we have — that's the deal we signed up for with a single cluster.
It was mine and it was avoidable: no CONCURRENTLY, no staging soak, shipped at 4:30 on a Friday. Postmortem Monday. I'm buying the retro donuts for a month.
